P069.title: On use of train-track-subgrade dynamic model for investigating the train-induced cumulative deformation of subgrade and its dynamic effects
P069.authors: Z Li, L Xu, W Wang, J Zhang, J Wang, B Peng, Z Zeng
P069.label: Li等（2024）

complete_examples.text: Although the cumulative deformation of the subgrade for the ballastless track is small compared with that of ballasted track, its effect on the vertical response of the train-track-subgrade interaction system is obvious.

The train-track-subgrade interaction is established as the model fundament, and the empirical model of soil cumulative deformation prediction is introduced to realize the joint analysis of the train-induced cumulative deformation of the subgrade and its effect on the performance of the time-varying dynamic system.
